query:
SELECT o.id
        FROM orgs o
        WHERE o.storage_limit IS NOT NULL
            AND ($1::text IS NULL OR o.id = $1)
            AND o.storage_limit < (
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n), 0)
                FROM (
                    SELECT c.size AS n
                    FROM caches c
                    WHERE c.org_id = o.id
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT e.size
                    FROM go_entries e
                    JOIN caches c ON c.id = e.cache_id
                    WHERE c.org_id = o.id
                        AND e.generation = c.go_generation
                        AND e.uploaded_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND e.expires_at > NOW()
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT e.size
                    FROM sccache_entries e
                    JOIN caches c ON c.id = e.cache_id
                    WHERE c.org_id = o.id
                        AND e.generation = c.sccache_generation
                        AND e.uploaded_at IS NOT NULL
                        AND e.expires_at > NOW()
                ) usage
            )
        ORDER BY o.id
